title: The 5 Best Milk Frothers Under $50
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for milk frothers under $50, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at milk frothers under $50 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Bodum Bistro Electric Milk Frother
products.blurb: Key specs: 10-ounce stainless steel body, Heats and froths in one cycle, Non-stick interior chamber.
strengths: Simple single-button use, nothing to configure wrong
Compact stainless design fits most kitchens
limitations: No cappuccino/latte-specific settings or temperature adjustment
Non-stick interior needs gentle hand washing rather than a dishwasher on most versions
features: Heats and froths in one cycle

products.name: Zulay Original Milk Frother
products.blurb: Key specs: Handheld battery-powered whisk, Under $15, Stainless steel whisk head.
strengths: Works in any mug, no dedicated jug to clean
limitations: Still doesn't heat milk regardless of the higher budget ceiling
Foam is coarser than the Bodum's heat-and-froth cycle

products.name: Maestri House DualFro 400 Milk Frother
limitations: Care instructions vary by listing; check before dishwashing

products.name: Maestri House 3-in-1 Automatic Milk Frother, 240 ml
strengths: Hot foam, cold foam and warm milk
limitations: Check the listing's care instructions before dishwashing

products.name: PowerLix 4-in-1 Automatic Milk Frother
limitations: Jug cleaning needs care around the heating base

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
